newsitem.title: USA: City National, Riverside to merge.
newsitem.headline: City National, Riverside to merge.

text.p: City National Corp and Riverside National Banck said they reached an agreement for Riversided to be merged into City National in a transaction valued at $39 million.

Under the deal, shareholders of Riverside National Bank shareholders will receive cash, stock or a combination of both valued at $18 per share. City National said it will use previously repurchased shares as well as an additional 400,000 shares authorized by its board of directors to be repurchased in the near future for the stock portion of the transaction.
City National said the transaction is expected to be completed during the first quarter of 1997 and to be accretive to City National's 1997 earnings.
